question: when did aims launch the pilot co-operative education program
evidence: In the Academic year, 2015/2016, AIMS introduced the pilot Cooperative Education Program.

question: how is co-op student time split between coursework and internship
answer: 18 months total: 10 months of academic coursework and 6 to 8 months of industry internship.
evidence: The Co-op students undergo 18 months of training: 10 months of academic/course work (given by international visiting lecturers, backed by permanent tutors) and 6 to 8 months of internship with AIMS industry partners
